info.title: Mac Control HTTP API
info.description: Documentation revision reviewed 2026-11-04 against this repository. All current /api/ GET/POST operations; not a negotiated runtime API version. The separate openapi.json documents Notifier /v1/ routes. Native helper response shapes are intentionally extensible.

servers.description: Default origin; use an allowed LAN host and configured port as appropriate.
Optional configured Tailscale Serve mount; mbp15 uses this tailnet hostname.

externalDocs.description: Human guide and API reference as JSON Markdown

all_requests: source IP is private, loopback or link-local according to Python ipaddress

Host hostname is in startup allowlist and port equals configured port, or exact configured HTTPS Tailscale Serve host with loopback peer and matching X-Forwarded-Host and X-Forwarded-Proto=https; no userinfo
Forwarded headers are rejected outside the configured loopback HTTPS Serve context; Tailscale-Funnel-Request is rejected
post: Origin must exactly equal http:// plus Host for direct access or the configured HTTPS origin for trusted Tailscale Serve
application/json object with Content-Length from 1 through 4096 bytes

get.summary: Read optional Notifier copy activity through the local bridge
get.description: First integration use case. After authorization, pulls GET /v1/snapshot over fixed loopback with a server-held administrator bearer. 2-second timeout; 2 MiB cap; environment proxies disabled. Upstream/configuration failures caught by the bridge return HTTP 200 available=false. No ingestion, WebSocket or browser bearer auth. Local browser hides activity on fallback/request failure.

200.description: Successful request; inspect payload availability, capability and error fields.

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked session (loginRequired=true), or incorrect sign-in password.

get.summary: Read host battery, Tailscale and Claude plan usage status
get.description: Read-only local commands, two-second timeout each, shared ten-second demand-driven cache. Unavailable sensors return HTTP 200 with explicit unknown states; no peers, addresses or account data are returned. Claude usage comes only from the private file written by claude_usage.py from the Claude Code status line and from a background Claude Code usage check that a cache refresh may start (at most every five minutes, no prompt or model call); Mac Control reads no credentials and does not contact Anthropic itself. Codex usage is read through a local codex app-server account/rateLimits/read request at most every five minutes (30-second timeout, never concurrent), with Codex managing its own sign-in. No conversation or model turn is started; only codex quota windows are retained in memory.

200.description: Successful request; inspect payload availability, capability and error fields.

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked session (loginRequired=true), or incorrect sign-in password.

macControlSession.name: mac_control
macControlSession.description: HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/ for direct access, or configured path_prefix/ with Secure for trusted Tailscale HTTPS. Ordinary server expiry 24h with browser-session cookie; remembered expiry 30d and Max-Age=2592000. Fixed expiry; password change revokes all sessions.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exact http://Host origin for direct requests, or the explicitly configured HTTPS origin for trusted loopback Tailscale Serve requests.

HardwareState.description: Extensible native/control-manager state. Unsupported numeric controls can be null; inspect capabilities and error.

ControlRequest.description: Value must be numeric; JSON booleans are rejected.

FanRequest.description: Target uses Celsius and needs helper v2+. Constant needs helper v3+, JSON integer RPMs (not float literals), one per detected fan in reported order, within firmware limits.

FanStatus.description: Helper-dependent fields; GET and stats embed status without adding time; POST adds epoch time. Contains actual fan readings and target prediction/learning metadata when available.

password.description: Only when mounted=true; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; no CR, LF or NUL. Never persisted as a mount preference.

items.description: Currently connected eligible USB target. Native helper fields include volume UUID id, name, model, size, connected, mounted, locked, state and volume metadata.

requiresPassword.description: True when a mount/unlock error leaves the target locked; ordinary mount failures on unlocked targets do not request a password.

PowerSnapshot.description: Epoch timestamps in seconds; selected history is watts, today.history is cumulative Wh. Nulls preserve gaps. Daily totals reflect observed coverage; raw samples retained for 24 hours, daily totals for 90 days.

Connection.description: helperPath appears only for direct loopback clients (not Serve); addresses is omitted.

claude.description: Claude plan usage as of the last Claude Code report (status line or usage check), not a live reading. Concurrent reports are merged so usage within a window never decreases.

state.description: not-configured: nothing has been written yet; unavailable: the usage file is unreadable or invalid.

updatedAt.description: Epoch seconds of the last update.

usedPercent.description: Percent of the window used, one decimal place.

resetsAt.description: Epoch seconds when the window resets.

fiveHour.description: Null when not reported or once resetsAt has passed.

usedPercent.description: Percent of the window used, one decimal place.

resetsAt.description: Epoch seconds when the window resets.

sevenDay.description: Null when not reported or once resetsAt has passed.

modelWeekly.description: Per-model weekly windows from the Claude Code usage check (for example Fable). Expired entries are omitted.

resetsAt.description: Epoch seconds when the window resets.

codex.description: Codex plan quota windows from a background local app-server account/rateLimits/read request. Latest successful reading retained in memory on failure; no credentials or account details returned.

state.description: checking before the first check; not-configured if the Codex CLI is absent; unavailable if no successful reading exists.

updatedAt.description: Epoch seconds of the last successful update.

usedPercent.description: Percent of the window used, one decimal place.

resetsAt.description: Epoch seconds when the window resets.

windowMinutes.description: Reported quota window duration in minutes.

primary.description: Null when not reported or once resetsAt has passed.

usedPercent.description: Percent of the window used, one decimal place.

resetsAt.description: Epoch seconds when the window resets.

windowMinutes.description: Reported quota window duration in minutes.

secondary.description: Null when not reported or once resetsAt has passed.

watts.description: Whole-system sensor W, not an estimate.

connected.description: May integrate with previous recorded point; false at startup or a gap.

cumulative_wh.description: Recorded energy for this day at this sample, Wh.

memory.description: Physical memory in bytes; free is total minus used.

download.description: Bytes per second, derived from consecutive counter readings.

upload.description: Bytes per second, derived from consecutive counter readings.

items.description: id/name plus rpm, target, minimum, maximum in RPM.
